description: Fetch one post by its URL: its text, images, author, published_at, reaction_count and comment_count. repost_count and the reactions by kind are null: the source gives the total only. Use linkedin/comments for its comments and linkedin/reactions for who reacted. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

url.description: The post's URL: `https://www.linkedin.com/posts/…-activity-<id>-…`, or `https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:<id>`. A link by the share's id works too: `urn:li:ugcPost:<id>`, `urn:li:share:<id>` or `/posts/…-ugcPost-<id>-…`.

name: get_linkedin_post
title: Get one LinkedIn post
